title: Night Market Event Pack
tests: Delivers three finished, coordinated event assets with format-appropriate layouts and a readable 10-second reel.

faults.what: The reel uses plain white sans-serif text on a dark rectangular panel, unlike the gold serif-led image designs, making it feel less like part of a matching pack.
Unrequested, indistinct vertical glyphs appear floating in the reel's sky, creating a visible generated-text artifact.

judge.summary: All three correctly sized assets include readable, accurate event details and warm blue-and-gold imagery, though the reel is less stylistically coordinated and contains stray background glyphs.

must_haves.item: Three separate finished assets are delivered: a 4:5 poster, a 9:16 story image and a 9:16 reel.
must_haves.why: The supplied poster, story image and reel frames show the requested formats as separate assets.

must_haves.item: All three visibly use warm lantern imagery and a coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design.
must_haves.why: Both images feature glowing gold lanterns against midnight blue; the reel combines a dark blue market scene with warm gold lighting and prominent lanterns later in the clip.

must_haves.item: Each asset includes the exact event name, date, time, venue and free-entry wording supplied.
must_haves.why: All five required text strings are readable and correct in both images and the reel.

must_haves.item: The reel runs for 10 seconds and contains visible animation or motion rather than being only a still image.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 10 seconds, and the sampled frames show changing market perspectives, vendor positions and lantern placement.

must_haves.item: Text is legible and unclipped in both images, and the reel holds its event details long enough to read.
must_haves.why: Image text is fully within the frame, and the reel's large, high-contrast event details remain consistently visible from 1.3 through 8.8 seconds.
